messages:
noah: Quick announce sync  finalizing Friday publish. Marketing needs: canonical changelog URL, a single short landing redirect, explicit canary window, and a 2-bullet migration note. Target Fri 09:00 PT.
anya: I'll prep the redirect page and add anchors: #whats-new, #migration, #webinar. Want a single short URL for the email + tweet.
carlos: Changelog will be committed today. I'll post the canonical link by 5pm PT. Ops: can you confirm a safe canary plan we can advertise?
ops-bot: deploy-bot: proposed canary schedule: 09:00 PT start -> 20m canary at 10% -> 40m gradual ramp to 50% -> hold 60m -> full at +2:00 if green. Rollback triggers: 5xx >0.15% for 5m or p95 latency +12% vs baseline. PD contacts: eng-oncall -> carlos, eng-sre -> rina. Reminder ping at 08:45 PT.
noah: Marketing also wants: two subject lines for a 12hr A/B, a tweet-sized line, and a 25s webinar blurb. Can someone paste drafts?
anya: Subjects: A) "New release: safer LLM rollouts and lower inference cost" B) "Ship LLM features with confidence  canaries + migration guides"
anya: Tweet: "Lower inference cost & risk with smarter batching, KV cache, and targeted canaries. Read + register: https://events.redwood.ai/launch-2024"
carlos: Webinar blurb: "Join our live demo to see canary rollouts, rollback triggers, and migration steps. Fri 09:00 PT / 17:00 CEST / 01:00 KST. Register: https://events.redwood.ai/launch-2024"
noah: Inbound lead routing  Sales wants region split and UTM capture. Can we add headers X-Region + X-UTM and a routing table?
sales-bot: sales-bot: sample mapping applied in staging: NA->sdr-na, EMEA->sdr-emea, APAC->sdr-apac. If any region >75/day, forward to growth@redwood.ai.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging payload example:
```http
POST /api/register
Headers: {"Content-Type":"application/json","X-Region":"NA","X-UTM":"launch-2024"}
Body: {"email":"jane@example.com","company":"Acme"}
```
press: Press embargo: request for 24h embargo for select reporters. Can we provide a private preview URL for docs and the press kit?
carlos: Yes, will create a preview token at /preview/launch-2024 and share with press list. Will post token in the press channel.
noah: Migration snippet (2 bullets) for the post & docs please. Keep it short and actionable.
anya: Migration snippet: "1) Pin current model version before upgrading. 2) Start at 10% canary; validate p95 & 5xx thresholds, then ramp."
carlos: Final changelog (live by 17:00 PT): https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2024-12/changelog.html. I'll drop the commit hash when pushed.
noah: One more ask  we need a 1-paragraph blog header + quick 2-line summary for social. Drop by EOD?
anya: Blog header draft: "Today were launching targeted rollout tooling and docs to make LLM inference updates safer and more cost-efficient. Smart batching and KV cache reduce unit costs; canary workflows make updates reliable. Join our webinar for a walkthrough."
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary scheduled: 2024-12-06T09:00:00-08:00 -> canary_end 09:20, ramp 09:20-10:00, hold until 11:00, full 11:00. Reminder ping at 08:45 PT.
sales-bot: sales-bot: registration payloads now include region & utm fields; routing tests green in staging. Mapping owned by sales-ops (anya).
noah: Thanks team. Marketing will collate assets (tweet, A/B subjects, short header image, migration bullets, press preview token) and post final announce packet by 20:00 PT to #announce. I'll schedule send for Fri 09:00 PT. :rocket: 
carlos: :thumbsup:
anya: :sparkles:
ops-bot: deploy-bot: reminder created for 2024-12-06T08:45:00-08:00 to start canary watch and post the announce.
